pkgmetadata.longdescription: Claude Desktop is Anthropic's official desktop application for Claude.ai. This ebuild repackages the upstream Linux .deb served from Anthropic's own apt repository (downloads.claude.ai) — a prebuilt Electron application that bundles its own Electron runtime and app.asar. Nothing is compiled; the .deb's declared dependencies are mapped to Gentoo atoms and the /usr tree (binary, resources, hicolor icons, and the claude:// scheme-handler desktop entry) is installed verbatim.

use.flag: Install a setuid-root chrome-sandbox helper for Electron's hardened namespace sandbox. With this disabled, Claude is launched with --no-sandbox instead.
Pull in QEMU and OVMF for Claude's local VM sandbox ("computer use" / cowork), which boots the bundled microVM image via virtiofsd.
